`inspectWorkspaceDataVersion` delegates to `inspectStoredWorkspaceData` and returns migration status. `readStoredWorkspaceDataSnapshot` captures config and, for `0.0.11` through `0.1.0`, the Package/Entry/Macro records; it can throw before an inspection status exists. `readDashboardWorkspaceData` builds this snapshot once, runs `readOverview` and `inspectStoredWorkspaceData` concurrently, and throws after both only when inspection is `invalid`.

`readOverview` performs Dashboard config, relationship, and Library work. `readLibraryMeta`, `readLibraryGraph`, and `readLibraryCountersSnapshot` have independent tagged-result and tolerance policies. Direct entity reads can use a different filesystem adapter from migration inspection.

A `current` migration inspection MUST NOT be interpreted as proof that every Dashboard or Library read succeeds. A `future` inspection is not itself thrown by `readDashboardWorkspaceData` and can be returned with an overview if that overview succeeds. Conversely, a tolerant Library read MUST NOT be interpreted as workspace-schema validity.
